name: @ship/viewer
description: Ship Viewer pack — the content-renderer ROUTER (`<ship-viewer>` dispatcher). Reads a resolved source, resolves the renderer through @ship/sail-media's pure createMimeRegistry() engine seeded with this router's default kind→TAG table, and renders the matching child via `{#match kind()}`. Leaf renderers are the @ship/sail-media `sui-media-*` tags; markdown/code/json/diff/tabular arms compose @ship/sail-primitives; the pdf kind renders `<ship-pdf>` from @ship/pdf (a SHIP-tier vendored-pdf.js renderer).
